meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

copy.tagline: 将上游更新选择性合并到本地定制版本中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着定制版开源项目，需要定期合并上游更新
copy.tagline_en: Selectively merge upstream updates into your customized fork
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized fork and need to regularly merge upstream changes

howto.what: 运行 /update-nanoclaw 后，它会将 NanoClaw 上游更新合并到你的自定义安装中，保留你的修改。过程包括备份、预览、选择合并方式、解决冲突、验证构建和测试。
howto.when: 在 Claude Code 中输入 /update-nanoclaw 时触发。适用于同步 NanoClaw 上游更新的场景。

howto.what_en: Running /update-nanoclaw merges upstream NanoClaw changes into your custom install while preserving your modifications. It creates backups, shows a preview, lets you choose merge/cherry-pick/rebase, resolves conflicts, and validates the build.
howto.when_en: Triggered by entering /update-nanoclaw in Claude Code. For users with a customized NanoClaw fork needing upstream updates.
